'''Treemo''' was a male [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] working for [[Graata]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he traveled to [[Voss]], where he asked an Imperial to procure him [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] weapons, to be reproduced and manufactured by Graata.
